title: LiNeS: Post-training Layer Scaling Prevents Forgetting and Enhances Model Merging
mechanism: Post-training edit: scale each layer's fine-tuning delta linearly with depth, shallow layers near pretrained, deep layers keep the task update.
adaptation: Zero training on house and PF checkpoints; scale encoder deltas by depth, plus the inverse ordering because our erasure sits in layer3/4; BN stats recomputed; scale chosen on val.
evidence: Reduces forgetting and improves OOD generalisation and multi-task merging in vision and NLP benchmarks (abstract; numbers not retrieved).
min_experiment: Existing checkpoints, val-chosen scale; kill if no setting beats raw by +0.005 val relF1@2.
